**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

- **§ 12.3 (p0051)** expressly negates any non-compete or field-of-use restraint on us: we remain free to develop, acquire, licence, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and conduct business in any field or territory, with Vendor acknowledging no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment.
- **§ 2.1 (p0013)** reinforces this with no minimum quantity or purchase commitment.
- **§ 12.4 (p0052)** is a competition restraint binding **Vendor** only — favourable to us, so not flagged.
- **§ 13.4 (p0057)** contains only ordinary acceptable-use/licence-scope limits (reverse engineering, interference, security bypass), not a field-of-use or competitive restriction.

No redline proposed.
